scope: Official general DateTime subset; not a full provider schema
provider_rule: Fields are set and returned with minute precision, seconds and milliseconds zero
new_intents: Canonicalize only accounting-field copies before immutable preview; preserve precise source and physical-event timestamps
legacy_readback: Accept exact original millisecond instant or exact UTC floor of original minute, never an arbitrary nearby instant

observed_live.demand: minute-normalized moment observed on one owner-controlled draft
observed_live.customerorder: not independently asserted by this fixture

identity_money_reservation_checks: Unchanged; normalization is not independent evidence of physical shipment, payment or return
